title: Candidate account shortlist (v1) — Customer Reference Program
content:
Working shortlist for 8–10 week push.

Scoring rubric (readiness_score 1–5):
5 = verbal commitment + clear champion + legal path understood + can share logo/quote (and ideally at least ranges for metrics)
4 = strong champion + product success + likely reference calls; public asset possible but needs legal/security review
3 = healthy account + good story but unknown approvals / weak champion / unclear metrics
2 = risk flags (recent escalations, procurement friction) or low willingness to speak
1 = do not pursue this cycle

Columns:
company | segment | primary_contact_title | relationship_owner | owner_role | product_usage | deployment_mode | reference_type_target | readiness_score | story_angle | proof_points_to_validate | key_risks | constraints/notes | permissions_status | next_outreach_date | last_touch | hubspot_record

Aster Education | mid-market | Head of Data | Rachel Kim | CSM | Hosted API | Hosted | Public case study | 2 | Cost controls for seasonal spikes; batching/caching | cost per request; autoscaling behavior | low bandwidth; metrics hard to gather | offer lightweight quote-only asset | Not started | 2025-11-14 | 2025-10-01 (CS note) | hubspot:company-aster-education (new)

Notes / ops:
- Tracking source of truth: this sheet + HubSpot properties (Isabelle to confirm fields). Any changes here should be reflected in HubSpot within 48h.
- Reference load guardrails: target max 2 calls/month per customer; enforce cooldown after heavy usage (CS to approve scheduling).
- Metric disclosure: default to ranges unless customer explicitly approves exact numbers; always include measurement method + confidence note.
- Next step this week: prioritize 5 accounts for outreach (Northwind, Helios, Polaris, Atlas, Aurora) and 3 backups (Cascade, Greenfield, Orchard).
